psychological_meaning: Olive drab is often associated with nature, peace, and resilience. It evokes feelings of stability, conservation, and practicality. Due to its historical use in military contexts, it can also symbolize camouflage, duty, and preparedness. Its muted tone makes it a grounding and reassuring color.
